name: The News API
tagline: Global news search and top headlines API with multi-language coverage
description: The News API aggregates news articles from thousands of sources worldwide. It provides endpoints for top headlines, all-news search, and similar-article discovery with filters for language, country, category, and date range.

auth.details: API token via query parameter api_token (self-serve signup)

use_cases: fetch top headlines for a country
filter news by language or category
find similar articles to a URL
